# Documentation Record Templates

Copy the relevant template for a real decision, asset batch, content approval, or release. Replace every bracketed field; do not commit records containing private messages, legal names, credentials, contracts, or sensitive contact details.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [`ASSET_INTAKE_RECORD.md`](ASSET_INTAKE_RECORD.md) | Rights, provenance, privacy, source, derivatives, and placement for an asset family/batch |
| [`CONTENT_APPROVAL_RECORD.md`](CONTENT_APPROVAL_RECORD.md) | Public copy, lore, story, resource, metric, schedule, link, or support approval |
| [`DECISION_RECORD.md`](DECISION_RECORD.md) | Durable product, architecture, hosting, policy, or budget decision |
| [`RELEASE_EVIDENCE_RECORD.md`](RELEASE_EVIDENCE_RECORD.md) | Commit-specific automated/manual/host evidence and rollback |

Store completed records in an owner-approved location. Repository-safe records may live under `docs/records/` if they contain no private evidence; otherwise commit only a safe reference ID in the relevant manifest/governance entry.

An unchecked template is not evidence.
